summary: Edge-case tests for the @fuzzer room agent
prompt: Write ONE new file tests/test_fuzzer_agent_edges.py with extra edge-case pytest tests for agents/fuzzer_agent.py (class FuzzerAgent). Do NOT modify any other file (in particular not agents/fuzzer_agent.py, tests/test_fuzzer_agent.py, tests/fakes.py, targets/**). Read first: docs/AGENTS_SPEC.md section 2 '@fuzzer', agents/fuzzer_agent.py, tests/test_fuzzer_agent.py (reuse its helpers by importing them: `from tests.test_fuzzer_agent import SETTINGS, make_fuzzer, write_ledger, translator_says, fuzzer_posts, matrix_state, assert_mention_hygiene, MIG_A, MIG_B, targets` - importing the module-scoped `targets` fixture makes it available; the `room`/`registry` fixtures you should redefine locally), tests/fakes.py (FakeRoom) and agents/runtime.py. Rules: never bind fixed ports (use tests.procs.free_port()); never write targets/modern_fastapi/app/lists.py; no live Switch; keep the whole file under ~40 s runtime (use n_random small, rev_timeout <= 1.5 s). Prefer tests that need NO real targets: for /_meta use a tiny in-process HTTP server (http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer in a daemon thread on a free port) whose /_meta JSON you control, and point legacy_url at a closed free port so run_campaign raises CampaignError. Cover at least: (1) rev appears only after a delay (meta server switches rev after ~0.5 s) -> the agent waits and proceeds (then fails the campaign loudly because legacy is down: one '⚠️' post mentioning 'could not run', no matrix document, registry file not created or empty); (2) /_meta rev matches but has import_error -> '⚠️' post containing 'failed to import', no campaign; (3) /_meta unreachable (closed port) -> '⚠️' after the timeout mentioning 'no answer'; (4) rev given in upper case matches a lower-case /_meta rev; (5) malformed decisions from a human, e.g. '@fuzzer re-verify rev=abcdef123456 migration=MIG-1 — human decisions applied: preserve D-1 and deprecate D-1' -> '⚠️ malformed command'; the same from the cutover-gate agent -> ignored (no fuzzer post); (6) handoff carries decisions but there is no ledger document -> '⚠️', no campaign; (7) ledger document without a state block / with invalid decision values ('keep') -> '⚠️', no campaign; (8) matrix document with corrupt JSON state created by the fuzzer itself -> on_connected posts '⚠️ could not rehydrate' and starts with an empty matrix; (9) a sender that is not a room participant (FakeRoom: enqueue an event via room._queues['fuzzer'].put(room._event(FakeMessage(...sender='mallory'...))) or similar) cannot trigger a campaign; (10) status/help from another agent are answered, without any '@' in the reply; (11) using the real `targets` fixture: no ledger in the room and a plain shadow-test -> an 'ℹ️ no ...Ledger' notice then a normal campaign with decisions == {} and 5 open clusters D-1..D-5. Assert exact MARK prefixes from agents.commands.MARK. Every test must pass: run `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_fuzzer_agent_edges.py` until green. If a test reveals what you believe is a genuine bug in agents/fuzzer_agent.py, do not change the agent: mark that test with pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason='BUG: ...') and describe the bug precisely in the reason.
